questions.question: A study was done on the weights of different types of fish in a pond. A random sample of fish were caught and marked in order to ensure that none were weighed more than once. The sample contained 150 largemouth bass, of which 30% weighed more than 2 pounds. Which of the following conclusions is best supported by the sample data?
options: The majority of all fish in the pond weigh less than 2 pounds.
The average weight of all fish in the pond is approximately 2 pounds.
Approximately 30% of all fish in the pond weigh more than 2 pounds.
Approximately 30% of all largemouth bass in the pond weigh more than 2 pounds.
questions.skill: Inference from Sample Statistics and Margin of Error
questions.teachingTopic: 判断抽样结论的合理性

questions.question: A simple random sample of 150 students at a school is surveyed about a policy. Which conclusion is most reasonable?
options: The results may be generalized to students at a school, subject to sampling variability.
The results prove how every person in the country feels.
The survey establishes that the policy causes the reported opinions.
No conclusion about the sampled population is possible.
questions.explanation: A is correct. A random sample supports generalization to the population from which it was drawn, with uncertainty.
questions.skill: Inference from Sample Statistics and Margin of Error
questions.teachingTopic: 判断抽样结论的合理性

questions.question: A survey about a policy receives 160 voluntary responses on an online forum used by some residents of a town. Which conclusion is most reasonable?
options: The responses perfectly represent all residents of a town.
The responses describe the volunteers but may not represent the full population.
The survey proves the policy causes participation.
A larger number of volunteer responses automatically removes selection bias.
questions.explanation: B is correct. Voluntary response can systematically differ from the full population.
questions.skill: Inference from Sample Statistics and Margin of Error
questions.teachingTopic: 判断抽样结论的合理性
